_about: ReaPersona. Each style: a shortcut layer (Main alt-N) + a theme + 'feel' (settings and mouse behaviours, put back when you switch away) + MIDI editor keys. Keys not listed fall through to your own shortcuts. Every key is the DAW's default from its maker's documentation (docs). keys: [key, REAPER command id | named id | 'MAIN:<key>' (whatever your Main section runs there) | 'script:<DAW Styles action>', what the DAW calls it]. midi_keys: [key, REAPER MIDI editor action name (or a list run in order), what the DAW calls it, times to run]. feel: ['toggle', command, wanted state, what] or ['mouse', context, modifier flag (1 Shift, 2 Ctrl, 4 Alt), REAPER behaviour, what]. Change keys here, then run install_shortcuts.py with REAPER closed. feel also takes ['dock', window, side, shown, what]; recommends lists extensions (core.EXTENSIONS); kind 'theme' puts a style on the Themes page.
